### Findings checked and refused (no change)

- Unit 1 መሐሉ as the 2mp imperative (the drafter's flagged crux): kept. Perfect 3mp and imperative are the same spelling; ከመ ኢታንግሡ is 2mp and ወመሐሉ 'swear!' has precedent in the known forms. The following ወመሐሉ (unit 3) is the perfect, as drafted.
- Unit 1 'David, son of Solomon' for Menelik: kept, as in ch. 83–86.
- Unit 17 ወልዲ as 'his Son': kept (known-forms entry gives -ዲ for -ሁ; parallel ወመንፈሱ). Unit 23 ፈቃዲ 'his will': kept (commands are 'his').
- Unit 24 ዘመገበነ 'fed (?)' and ኢይትአተት 'withdrawn (?)': kept hedged; I can offer no better root without Dillmann.
- Unit 26 ይትሐበለዩነ 'plot against (?)': kept; ይጸብዑነ አጽባአ as cognate accusative: kept.
- Unit 20 ንግሥትሰ አንቲ እግዝእትየ ('You are queen, my lady'): kept; ዘአዘዝክኒ as 2fs: correct (-ኪ becomes -ክ before -ኒ).
- Units 32–34 speaker/addressee shift to the assembly (2mp እነግረክሙ): kept as drafted, hedged in the note (David–Menelik recounting the Jerusalem anointing to the assembly, or the narrator); I see no better reading.
- Unit 12 masculine verbs with አድባር: kept (?).
- Unit 6 ትዕይንት 'array (?)': kept, in line with chs. 41, 61.
- Unit 4 ኀይለ 'host' with (?) beside `l` 'strength-of': kept.
- Unit 18 ንጉሠ እስራኤል as construct describing Solomon: kept.
- Unit 19 ለአቤራቲሁ 'his needy (?)': kept hedged (no better guess).
- Chunking/`p` flags: unit 0 and unit 1 are the only paragraph starts in the packet; the 39-word unit 4 is under the ~45 limit.

### Findings checked and refused (no change)

- በሉኬ lemma ይቤ (house lemma for the defective 'say'; the note names ብህለ): kept; (?) already present.
- ኀስራ/ኀስሩ: lemma ኀሠረ with root written ḫ-s-r, 'diminished': kept; the ś/s difference is explained in the entry.
- ወሰገለ 'sorcery, divination (?)' against house 'sorcery, magic (?)': kept, same word and hedge.
- ለሰሚዕ/ወለሠዊዕ 'verbal noun' where the note says 'infinitive': kept, same thing.
- ለእ / ግዚኣብሔር split-word entries (lemma እግዚአብሔር on both halves, each stating it is part of one word): kept; sensible and each carries the full-word lemma.
- ዘመገበነ 'fed (?)', ኢይትአተት 'withdrawn (?)', ኢተሐዘብነ (house ተሐዘበ 'reckon, expect'), ቀነተ, ሠዊዕ, ጋኔን, ኢዮብልዮስ (lemma ኢዮቤልዮስ, the Jubilees form): kept; no evidence against.
